title: LIFE: land-cover change impacts on future extinctions, v1.01
description:
Global 1 arc-minute (1/60 deg, EPSG:4326) maps of the change in expected number of extinctions per km2 of land converted to arable, or restored to natural habitat, under five persistence-habitat loss curves (Eyres et al. 2025, Phil. Trans. R. Soc. B). Zarr V3, consolidated, zarr-conventions multiscales v0.1 with 5 levels (0 finest 10800x21600 at 1/60 deg .. 4 coarsest 675x1350), zstd level-5 codec, float32. 12 data variables total: 5 "score" arrays per scenario (arable_0.1/0.25/0.5/1.0/gompertz, restore_0.1/0.25/0.5/1.0/gompertz) plus one area-changed array per scenario (arable_area_changed, restore_area_changed). Score arrays have a leading taxon dim of size 5 (all, AMPHIBIA, AVES, MAMMALIA, REPTILIA); area arrays are [lat, lon] only. Values are NaN where no land changes under the scenario.

The brief for this fixture assumed LIFE scores were "proportions-like" and suggested a [0,1] rescale; the store's own per-variable statistics show otherwise: arable_0.25 (taxon "all") ranges about [-0.37, 0.76] extinctions/km2 and restore_0.25 ranges about [-0.69, 0.12] -- a signed, roughly-symmetric-about-zero impact score, not a bounded proportion. The render below uses a diverging colormap and the arable_0.25 (the paper's main analysis) real range instead.

Terms of reference prohibit commercial use and redistribution without permission from IBAT; license is declared "proprietary" with a link to the Zenodo record rather than a standard open license.

Expected browser outcome: draws (diverging ramp on arable_0.25, taxon "all").

arable_0.25.long_name: LIFE score, arable scenario, power-law persistence curve, exponent z = 0.25 (the paper's main analysis)

restore_0.25.long_name: LIFE score, restore scenario, power-law persistence curve, exponent z = 0.25 (the paper's main analysis)

arable_area_changed.long_name: area of land changed per pixel, arable scenario

restore_area_changed.long_name: area of land changed per pixel, restore scenario

arable-0.25.title: LIFE score, arable scenario, z=0.25, taxon 'all'
